text.en: In the three northern territories, there are mines for gold, lead, copper, diamonds and zinc.
text.fr: Dans les trois territoires du Nord, il y a des mines d'or, de plomb, de cuivre, de diamants et de zinc.

source.quote: There are gold, lead, copper, diamond and zinc mines.

verification.evidence: The Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon … There are gold, lead, copper, diamond and zinc mines.

text.en: Deposits of oil and gas in the northern territories are being developed.
text.fr: Dans les territoires du Nord, des gisements de pétrole et de gaz sont en cours de mise en valeur.

source.quote: Oil and gas deposits are being developed.

verification.evidence: The Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon … There are gold, lead, copper, diamond and zinc mines. Oil and gas deposits are being developed.

text.en: In Yukon, mining is still an important part of the economy.
text.fr: Au Yukon, l'exploitation minière demeure une part importante de l'économie.

source.quote: Mining remains a significant part of the economy.

verification.evidence: Thousands of miners came to the Yukon during the Gold Rush of the 1890s, as celebrated in the poetry of Robert W. Service. Mining remains a significant part of the economy.
